labels: Grab the box with one hand.
Checks the whole path from closed.

spatial_layout: Starting camera supplies flat view/right basis. Virtual floor anchor supplies floor Y. Cabinet front center at camera + view*140 cm, hinge 30 cm left. Cabinet shell local x=[0,60], y=[0,80], z=[-39,-1], closed door z=[-1,1], giving full 60x40x80 cm envelope. Obstacle center local (35,30,35). Clearance shares cabinet basis. Panel center local (30,110,8), width36cm, vertically adjacent above the cabinet with 3.25cm gap at default layout height53.5cm. This keeps controls within the central horizontal view of the narrow Preview. All world-fixed after initial placement; identity-scale obstacle collider wrapper at floor+30; basis baked into obstacle mesh and collider.
